'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Nick Olson LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Olson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Nick1652
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
